output.reframed_request: «Через 3 недели открываем вторую точку на Левом берегу. Нужен ажиотаж.» → Before the second location opens, build a list of nearby people who ask to be told when and where it opens, using a WhatsApp code from each video. Then turn that list, plus the first location's regulars, into steady paid visits at the Левый берег location over its first 4 weeks. A one-day queue for photos is not the goal.
output.business_objective: Average daily POS checks at the Левый берег location over days 1–28 after opening (assumed 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-27) reach at least 50% of location 1's average daily checks over the 4 weeks before. Both the 50% ratio and the opening date are assumptions. The absolute number will be set once the owner sends location 1's POS average.
output.marketing_objective: The audience is people within walking distance of the new Левый берег address who are looking for a place for their morning or lunch coffee: office workers, residents and students. A second group is location 1's regulars who live or work on Левый берег. Before opening day (assumed 2026-10-30), they send a coded message asking for the exact opening date and address. They then make their first paid visit at the new location within 14 days of opening (by 2026-11-13).

success_metric.name: Coded opening sign-ups for the new location (people who send a video's code to get the opening date and address)
success_metric.how_measured: Messages that contain a per-video code ({CODE}), counted from the weekly WhatsApp chat export or Instagram DMs (whichever channel Q3 picks) and deduplicated by contact. Supporting directional count: Левый берег POS checks for days 1–14, plus a barista tick sheet asking «Откуда узнали?» (1 tap per guest, opening week only).
success_metric.target: conservative 40 / expected 80 / stretch 150 coded sign-ups. These are assumptions: no baseline exists. The target is re-fixed on 2026-10-16 from week-1 coded chats per 1k views. Baseline: 0 (a new location with no list).

leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ the account's Reels median over its last 15 posts (pooled specialty_coffee median until there are 10 own posts per platform)
shares + saves per 1,000 views (the «скинь коллеге, рядом с офисом откроется» signal)
constraints: BUDGET: 0 ₸ (default). The boost question is asked once a pre-opening post qualifies (DR2), which is expected in week 2.

STAFF: ≤17 planned min/week, 20 including safety margin. One phone; audio usable only close to the phone. Staff are also busy setting up location 2, so the shoot runs in one session at location 1 or on the new site. (stated)

FILMING: baristas aged 20–25 are willing to appear (stated). Each barista's consent is recorded on camera before their first face shot. Regulars and customers only with consent recorded on camera. No minors without a parent's written OK. (stated + default)
PRICES: none usable. The ledger is empty, so no prices, menu items or numbers appear in content until there is a dated menu or price-list photo (evidence: facts_usable = [])
OFFER: none (default). An opening offer is a known unknown; nothing like «бесплатно», «скидка» or «первым N гостям» without the owner's exact terms (Q2).

DATES/ADDRESS: no opening date, address or countdown in audience copy until the owner confirms them in writing (evidence: known_unknowns). Until then the copy says «скоро на Левом берегу» and exact details go privately to people who send the code.

CAPACITY: new-location throughput is unknown. No «очередь», «мест мало», «успейте» or «только в день открытия». The CTA spreads first visits over the first 14 days instead of piling them onto day 1. (default)
REGULATED: not a regulated category. Still no health or energy claims about coffee or caffeine. (default)

AVOID: politics, religion, ethnicity, mocking customers, naming competitors or other Левый берег coffee shops. Правый/Левый берег jokes only if benign and about commuting or weather, never about people. (default)

ACCOUNTS: Instagram ~2.1k followers (assumed, unverified) and a 2GIS card for location 1 (stated sales channel). Unknown: TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp Business number, and a 2GIS card for the new location. Missing accounts become owner asks in step 2. Business accounts use commercial-library music only. (stated + default)
LANGUAGE: Russian on screen. Kazakh captions only after a native speaker checks them. (stated languages ru/kk + L9)
APPROVAL: the owner approves each weekly batch explicitly. Any opening offer, any new face and any spend need explicit approval. (default)
GUARDRAIL: median first reply to coded messages ≤15 min in working hours
GUARDRAIL: location 1's daily checks stay at or above its 4-week average while staff and attention shift to the opening (cannibalisation and service check)
GUARDRAIL: location 1's 2GIS rating does not drop below its current value; the new location's first reviews are monitored daily in weeks 1–2 after opening
assumptions: LADDER: «ажиотаж» → so that people come at opening → so that some of them become regulars → so that location 2 reaches normal daily checks quickly. The first number counted weekly is daily POS checks at location 2. Fork: an opening-day crowd (one day, visible, little value) vs sustained first-month visits (measurable, larger value). Chosen: sustained visits. The opening-day buzz is kept as SECONDARY.

JUDGMENT (the method does not cover this): A2 assumes WhatsApp closes the sale, but a coffee shop closes at the counter. So the countable pre-opening action is a coded opt-in for the date and address, and the business outcome is POS checks. Coded opt-ins later double as an opted-in list for an opening-day broadcast.

BOTTLENECK: awareness in the new catchment. Confidence: likely, by construction, since a new location has no footprint on Левый берег. A consideration layer probably sits behind it: «зачем менять свою привычную кофейню». Evidence: profile only (one location, loyal regulars); no chats or reviews ingested yet.

SECONDARY: opening-day buzz (a visible crowd, guests posting). It gets at most 20% of slots and is served by the same series. A conflicting ask («ажиотаж» vs unknown capacity) is resolved by steering visits across the first 14 days.
SECONDARY (possible, not stated): location 2 may need to hire baristas. If so, it needs a separate hiring brief with the РАБОТА code family and does not take launch slots.

REALISM: req_chats = 80 expected sign-ups (baseline 0; close rate not applicable because the sign-up is the outcome). req_views = 80 ÷ (0.3–3 per 1k [ASSUMPTION]) = 27k–267k. ach_views = 15 posts in 3 weeks × 300–1,000 median Reels views [ASSUMPTION for a ~2.1k account] × 1.8 = 8.1k–27k. ratio ≈ 1–33, so stretch to unrealistic organically. Time: 21 days is above 14 but too short for organic arms to learn. Levers: warm base (location 1 regulars via in-store mention and WhatsApp Status to opted-in contacts only), a 2GIS card for the new location before opening, and an owner-approved geo-boost of the best pre-opening post around the new address. Capacity: unknown, so the CTA spreads visits.

clarifying_questions: Дата и адрес второй точки: 1 — подтверждены, пришлите точную дату и адрес, их можно называть в роликах; 2 — могут сдвинуться, в роликах пишем только «скоро на Левом берегу». По умолчанию: 2 — точные детали отправляем лично тем, кто напишет код. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Будет ли акция к открытию: 1 — нет; 2 — да, напишите точно, что предлагаете, для кого, с какой по какую дату и есть ли лимит в день. По умолчанию: 1 — зовём без скидок и подарков. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Куда звать людей из роликов до открытия: 1 — в WhatsApp кофейни (пришлите номер; в рабочее время там отвечают в течение 15 минут); 2 — в директ Instagram; 3 — никуда, только подписка на Instagram. По умолчанию: 2. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.
output.push_back: Гарантировать ажиотаж за 3 недели не может никто: охват коротких видео непредсказуем, а алгоритму нужно время, чтобы найти людей именно с Левого берега. Поэтому успех считаем не в просмотрах. Считаем, сколько людей написали код из ролика, чтобы узнать дату и адрес, и сколько чеков будет на новой точке в первые 4 недели. По расчёту одной органики, скорее всего, не хватит, поэтому главные рычаги — ваши постоянные гости (бариста на первой точке, Статус WhatsApp), карточка новой точки в 2ГИС до открытия и, если решите, недорогое продвижение лучшего ролика вокруг нового адреса; дату, адрес и акции в роликах не называем, пока вы их не подтвердите.

request_type launch_or_event. Primary metric: coded opening sign-ups (40 conservative / 80 expected / 150 stretch, baseline 0, all assumed; re-fixed on 2026-10-16). Business metric: Левый берег POS checks on days 1–28. Bottleneck: awareness in the new catchment (likely). REALISM ratio ≈1–33, so organic alone is stretch to unrealistic. The text judge is barely better than chance on Shorts (ρ 0.11 overall, 0.07 retail, n=1,172). Long-form title patterns did not replicate. So rubric scores are priors only, the slate must be diverse and cheap, and no hook formula is assumed to work.

No price or menu slides made from photos. Brand-only product demos performed poorly (median 390 views vs a 2,300 channel median, n=48). So every coffee or process clip needs a guest's question, a human angle or real sound. A latte-art pour set to music is not enough on its own.

insights.insight: [tension] When a new coffee spot appears on their morning route on Левый берег, a person who already has a coffee habit wants a better cup closer to work. But an unknown place risks a bad cup and lost minutes before the workday, so they stay with their usual café or the office machine. We can show the real people and the real bar process that location 1's regulars keep coming back for, so the new spot stops being unknown. This moves coded sign-ups because the code is the only way to get the date and address.
insights.tension: Wants a better morning coffee nearby vs habit plus the fear of wasting a rushed morning on an unknown place.
insights.who_feels_it: Someone whose daily walk or drive to an office or home on Левый берег passes the new address and who already buys coffee somewhere else before work.
insights.content_reality: Barista hands, plus faces only after consent is recorded on camera, working the espresso machine and milk at «бар» (location 1), and later at «новая точка». HYPOTHESIS: every business-specific item is an assumption, so strength is capped at 2 and C4 test 1 (evidenced) is not yet met. NEEDS FACT before any claim: whether the same baristas or beans will work at location 2. Until confirmed, use recognition content only («знакомо?»), with no «те же бариста» or quality claim.

insights.insight: [friction] When someone sees «скоро на Левом берегу», they want to try it once it opens. But there is no date, no address and no 2GIS card to save, so the intent evaporates long before opening day. We can openly show the friction («дату пока не называем — напишите код, сообщим первыми лично») and then actually reply fast. This is the direct conversion step to the primary metric (coded sign-ups) and builds the opted-in list for opening-day broadcast.
insights.tension: Wants to remember and come vs having nothing concrete to remember it by (no date, address or map pin).
insights.who_feels_it: Viewers in the new catchment who are mildly curious but will not follow an account for three weeks to catch the announcement.
insights.content_reality: The closed or empty «новая точка» seen from inside, plus a screen-mode anonymised reply card showing what a person gets after sending the code (no real chat screenshot). This is a process promise, not a product claim, so it is truthful only if someone answers coded messages within 15 min in working hours (guardrail). The destination depends on intake Q3 (WhatsApp vs Instagram DM). HYPOTHESIS, strength capped at 2.

insights.insight: [moment] When a covered shopfront on their daily route is being fitted out, neighbours want to know «что тут будет?». But hoardings and «скоро открытие» posters say nothing, so they guess and walk on. We can show the inside of the new site week by week (empty room, machine unwrapped, first test shot), which is the opposite of the countdown-poster convention. Each episode ends with the code for the date, so curiosity converts into sign-ups during D−21 to D.
insights.tension: Curiosity about a closed space they pass every day vs nothing visible from the street.
insights.who_feels_it: People who walk or drive past the new address daily during the three weeks before opening.
insights.content_reality: «новая точка» during fit-out: boxes opened by hand, machine switched on for the first time, first test shot poured close to the phone. Light and noise are unknown until the reality scan. No dates, countdown or address on screen until the owner confirms them in writing. HYPOTHESIS: E21 is assumed and the site must be filmable. Strength capped at 2. Series-able (one episode per week of fit-out).

insights.insight: [proof] When a location-1 regular hears about a second location, they want their coffee closer to where they live or work. But they fear «там будет так же?» and that their own bar will lose its people, so they wait and see instead of trying it early. We can show the same morning ritual (dial-in tasting) at «бар» and then the first dial-in at «новая точка». This turns warm-base regulars on Левый берег into early sign-ups and repeat visitors, the cheapest lever in the REALISM math.
insights.tension: Wants the familiar coffee closer vs fear that the copy will not match the original and that their own bar changes.
insights.who_feels_it: Existing regulars of location 1 who live or work on Левый берег and currently cross the city for their usual cup.
insights.content_reality: Dial-in ritual at «бар»: shot pulled, tasted, grinder adjusted, filmed at 30 cm. The same ritual later at «новая точка». NO PROOF YET: the ritual and the location-2 staffing are unconfirmed (E22), so until the owner confirms, this is recognition content only («как мы настраиваем кофе утром») with no «так же, как на первой точке» claim. HYPOTHESIS, strength capped at 2.

insights.insight: [identity] When choosing a regular coffee spot, people want to be a known face («мой бариста знает мой заказ»). But at a new place everyone is a stranger, so they default to where they are already known. We can introduce the baristas as a recurring cast (who they are, what they drink themselves, who will stand behind the new bar) so that the new catchment meets the people before the place. This builds the pull that brings first visits and later repeats.
insights.tension: Wants a place where they are recognised vs a new spot where they know nobody.
insights.who_feels_it: Morning regulars-to-be who value routine and small talk, plus location-1 regulars who follow their favourite barista.
insights.content_reality: Barista close-talk with the phone at 30 cm in a quiet spot at «бар» (faces only after consent is recorded on camera), and hands making their own drink. Which barista moves to location 2 is a NEEDS FACT (owner). Loyalty-to-people is a hypothesis (E16, 0 observed). Recognition and character content only. Strength capped at 2.

insights.insight: [content_reality] The bar's raw sounds (grinder burst, tamp, knock box, steam-wand hiss rising as milk heats) are heard up close only by the person standing at the counter, and category posts usually bury them under music. We can record them at 20–30 cm, which is the weak phone's one strength. To avoid the pure-demo underperformance seen in L006, the sound is tied to a viewer question (guess the sound, the stage, the drink). Effect on the objective: reach and recall in the new catchment, with a code end-card.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity gap: «снаружи этого никто не слышит» vs the music-over-latte-art convention.
insights.who_feels_it: Anyone scrolling in Астана, especially coffee drinkers who never stand close to the machine.
insights.content_reality: «бар» at location 1: grinder, tamp, knock box and steam wand recorded with the phone resting 20–30 cm away, no talking. Later the first steam-wand hiss at «новая точка». Contains no claims. Strength 2 (type cap 3, lowered because all evidence is assumption and the reality scan has not been done).

insights.insight: [myth] When non-specialty drinkers walk past a specialty café, they may want something better than a chain or a vending machine. But they may believe «спешелти — это пафосно, долго и дорого», so they never step in. We can show the process plainly and without price: what the barista actually checks and why the drink takes the time it does, framed as the barista's opinion. This lowers the consideration barrier behind awareness in a catchment where the brand is unknown.
insights.tension: Curious about better coffee vs a belief that the place is pretentious, slow or not for them.
insights.who_feels_it: Office workers near the new address who drink instant, chain or machine coffee and feel out of place in a «modern» café.
insights.content_reality: Barista hands and a close voice-over at «бар» walking through one drink. NO PROOF and NO PRICE: the belief itself is unsourced (E24), and price or «недорого» claims are banned until there is a dated menu (E03). Explanation and recognition only, framed as «бариста считает». No speed claims. HYPOTHESIS, strength capped at 2.

insights.insight: [identity] WILDCARD. When a location-1 regular commutes across the river for their usual coffee, they want it without the trip. But their favourite place is «на том берегу», so they either make the trip or settle. A benign «левый берег / правый берег» commute in-joke (about the trip and the weather, never about people) can give Левый берег viewers a local reason to share. The payoff, «теперь и на этом берегу», points to the code for the date.
insights.tension: Loyalty to a place vs the daily friction of getting there from the other bank.
insights.who_feels_it: People who live on one bank and work on the other, especially location-1 regulars based on Левый берег.
insights.content_reality: Real footage only: a cup carried out of «бар», a window view, labelled POV text. No identifiable passers-by. Location 1 being off Левый берег is itself an assumption (E14). Risk: the joke must stay benign under the AVOID constraint. Thin, assumption-only evidence, so strength 1. Kept as a high-distinctiveness wildcard.

insights.insight: [moment] When the first cold mornings hit Астана, commuters want something warm in hand on the way to work, but the usual stop is out of the way, so they skip it or grab whatever is closest. A real weather cue (steam from a cup at the door of the new site) ties the new location to the commute moment. Effect on the objective: a recall cue near opening week. Low distinctiveness, because peers post «согрейся» content.
insights.tension: Wants warmth on the cold walk to work vs no convenient stop on the route yet.
insights.who_feels_it: Morning walkers and bus commuters around the new address on cold or snowy days.
insights.content_reality: Steam rising from a cup held at the door of «новая точка» or «бар» on a genuinely cold morning, filmed when it happens (if-then trigger). No health or «согреет» claims, no date. Weather is an assumption to check against the forecast. Strength 1 (generic moment, assumption-only).

insights.insight: [identity] WILDCARD. When a new place opens in their neighbourhood, people want it to feel like theirs, but a brand that arrives fully formed feels like outsiders moving in, so locals stay indifferent. If the owner lets the Левый берег audience decide one real detail (a drink name, what is written on the window, the opening playlist), carries it out and shows it, the vote gives viewers a stake before opening, and voters become sign-ups.
insights.tension: Wants a neighbourhood place of their own vs a new business that ignores them.
insights.who_feels_it: Residents and office workers near the new address who comment on local happenings.
insights.content_reality: Window or chalkboard at «новая точка» showing the winning choice by hand, filmed close. NEEDS FACT (owner): which detail the audience may genuinely decide. Without it the idea cannot run, because asking and not following through breaks the participation rule. No evidence of demand, so strength 1. A high-variance exploration bet.

output.name: Left Bank launch — «Что тут будет?» (behind the closed door)
output.big_idea: Most openings put up a countdown poster. Instead, Левый берег watches this coffee shop come together from behind the closed door: the empty room, the first tamper on the counter, the machine being tuned shot by shot, and the baristas. Sending the video's code is the only way to get the date and address, delivered personally. Generative: there are 20+ episodes in the fit-out stages, viewer questions, test shots, the people and opening week. Provable: everything is filmed on site, with nothing claimed beyond what the camera shows. Measurable: every episode ends at a coded sign-up. Truth gate: this only runs once the owner confirms in writing that the Левый берег location exists and that the site can be filmed now (E02, E21).
output.single_minded_message_ru: Покажем изнутри, пока дверь ещё закрыта
output.why_this_wins:
The ledger is empty, so this message contains no fact ids. It is true by construction before opening, but it may be used only after the owner confirms the second location and filming permission (E02, E21 → NEEDS FACT). Why this design and not a countdown:
(1) I03 (moment, E21/E18/E11/E23): people who pass a covered shopfront every day want to know «что тут будет?», and the category convention is a poster that says nothing. A backstage series is the opposite of that convention, and the place can be filmed this week.
(2) I02 (friction, E02/E03/E15/E26/E09/E25): with no date, address or map pin, intent fades before opening day. Sending the code is the only way to get the details, so each view points at the one action we count. That action also builds an opted-in list for the opening-day message.
(3) I04 and I05 (warm base, E05/E14/E16/E22): location 1's regulars are the cheapest lever in the REALISM math (ratio ≈1–33 organically). ID18 and Status target them directly.
(4) Wildcards I08 (ID13), I06/I05 (ID24) and I02 honest_signal (ID06) cover variance and test identity, sensory and anti-sell drivers on a new client.

Every insight is strength ≤2 (assumption-only), so this is a bet on learning, not a forecast. Following L001, the rubric is only a prior. Following L006, no idea is a bare demo: every sound or process clip is tied to a viewer question or the code. Following L005, there are no price slides. Learning plan: 5 base posts a week across ≥4 drivers, read at 48 h. The target is re-fixed on 2026-10-16 from coded sign-ups per 1k views. Breakouts get follow-ups within 3 days because the window is only 21 days. Warm base, the 2GIS card and an optional geo-boost carry the volume that organic reach probably cannot. JUDGMENT: F6 assumes a 4-week runway. This window has 3 weeks, so reach and consideration run together from week 1, and conversion starts at D−10 (2026-10-20).

measurement.success_metric: Primary: coded opening sign-ups for the Левый берег location, meaning unique contacts who send a video or counter-card code asking for the date and address. Target: conservative 40 / expected 80 / stretch 150 by 2026-10-30. Baseline 0 (new location, no list). Target re-fixed on 2026-10-16 from week-1 coded sign-ups per 1k views. Business objective (read on 2026-11-30): average daily POS checks at Левый берег over days 1–28 after opening (assumed 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-27) reach ≥50% of location 1's average daily checks over the 4 weeks before. The ratio and date are assumptions, and the absolute number is set once the owner sends location 1's POS average.
measurement.attribution: Per-video codes, spoken or on screen for ≥2 s, in the caption and in the pinned comment, with a wa.me prefilled link or DM keyword wherever links are clickable (bio, story link sticker). The counter card and Status carry their own codes, so warm base is measured separately from video. Coded counts are deduplicated by contact and reported as a floor. Codeless messages asking about the new location are counted separately with «Откуда узнали?» and reported as an estimate. Opening days 1–14: barista tick sheet «Откуда узнали?» (видео в Instagram / проходил мимо / 2ГИС / с первой точки / друзья), directional. Opt-in→visit is estimated, never claimed, from tick-sheet «видео» counts against the size of the opted-in list. Левый берег POS checks vs location 1's 4-week average are directional and labelled as such. Code attribution window: 30 days.
leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ the IG Reels median of the last 15 posts (log ratio per engine); pooled specialty_coffee median for TikTok/Shorts until 10 own posts each
3-second hold / skip rate and average % watched
shares + saves per 1,000 views (the «скинь коллеге с Левого берега» signal)
comments per 1,000 views, including the bank split on ID13
audience city share for Астана (from account insights, if the owner grants access)
measurement.review_cadence: Every post at 48 h (allocation) and at 7 days (final). Weekly campaign read on Mondays (12.10, 19.10, 26.10, 02.11, 09.11). Daily coded sign-up count from D−7 (23.10) through opening week, because the window is short. Target re-fix on 2026-10-16. Phase review on 2026-11-09. Business-objective read (POS days 1–28) on 2026-11-30.

decision_rules: DR1 Read: every post at 48 h and at 7 days. Let M = the IG Reels median of the last 15 posts (fetched by 2026-10-11; planning value 300–1,000 views [ASSUMPTION]). TikTok/Shorts use their own or pooled medians.

DR2 Breakout: ≥3×M views at 48 h (e.g. ≥1,800 if M = 600), or shares+saves per 1k ≥2× the account median. Response within 3 days, not 7, because of the 21-day window: 2 follow-ups (part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment), pin it if it carries the code, put it on WhatsApp Status, and make it boost-eligible. At ≥10×M it becomes its own series, and the owner hears «вирусный» as a tail event, not a plan.

DR3 Hook failure: 3-second hold below 0.7× the account median → re-cut with a different first frame and hook (same rails), repost ≥7 days later, once only. Pre-opening re-posts after 2026-10-28 are skipped, and the footage moves to opening-week edits instead.
DR4 Body failure: hold is fine but completion is below 0.7× median → shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode of that series. No repost as is.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss, checked 2026-10-21: views ≥ plan but coded sign-ups per 1k < 0.3, or total coded sign-ups < 12 → before making more content, check that the code is visible ≥2 s, in the caption and pinned comment, that the bio link works, that the DM/WhatsApp destination is correct, and the reply time.

DR-R Reply guardrail: if the median first reply to coded messages exceeds 60 min in working hours in any 3-day window, pause the conversion series («Вопрос про новую точку») until it is fixed. Report it to the owner as the top leak.

DR-Q1 Facts gate: no date, address, countdown or «первыми» promise in any audience string until there is a written owner fact. If Q1 = 1, switch the conversion CTAs to «Напишите {CODE} — напомним в день открытия» with the date and address fact ids. If the opening date slips, posts already out stay as they are (none name a date), and the back-plan shifts with the new D.
DR6 Sign-up handling: if sign-ups are on plan but the opening-day «да» rate is <50% of coded contacts, rewrite the quick reply's opt-in line (one question, one next step).

DR7 Attention-only arm: in this short sprint, any wildcard arm (ID13, ID24 and its repeats) with ≥3 posts, ≥5,000 total views and 0 coded sign-ups while other arms convert → cap at 1 post/week. JUDGMENT: thresholds are lowered from 10 posts/10k views because the sprint is only 3 weeks before opening.
DR8 Retire: P(arm beats client median) < 0.10 after ≥8 posts → exploration floor for this client. This will rarely trigger within this sprint; the data stays in the pool.

DR9 Boost: only a DR2 post that has ≥1 coded sign-up or a conversion role, within the owner's cap per coded sign-up (formula in channels), geo-radius around the new address, window 19.10–05.11. Stop after spending 5× the cap with <3 coded sign-ups, or if cost per sign-up rises for 3 days in a row. Never with an unconfirmed offer.

DR10 Capacity: once the owner states the new location's daily capacity, if opening-week checks reach ≥80% of it, or the tick sheet or reviews mention waits or queues → pause «приходите» CTAs, push ID06-style spreading («приходите на второй неделе»), and shift to trust and process content.

DR-C Cannibalisation guardrail: if location 1's weekly checks fall >10% below its 4-week average for 2 consecutive weeks after opening → stop the counter card and any messaging that moves location-1 regulars. Keep the content aimed at new Левый берег people.

DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a fact (for example that the opening is later, or that the location is elsewhere) → pause that series, verify with the owner, and tell the owner the same day.

DR12 Pivot (compressed): if coded sign-ups on 2026-10-23 are < 10 (25% of conservative) and no arm has P > 0.6 → shift weight to the warm-base levers (counter card, Status, 2GIS card), recommend the geo-boost with the computed cap, and send the owner an honest 3-option report (boost / warm base only / accept a smaller opening list).
DR13 Claims: «победитель» only with P(best) ≥ 0.9, n ≥ 10 per contender, and an interval. In this sprint, expect «лидирует, рано судить».

DR14 Staff: staff are also setting up location 2. If card completion is <80% in any single week (not 2, given the window) → next card uses ≤2 locations, face-free shots, zero-minute ideas (ID17, ID18 types) and shorter takes.
DR15 Owner: rejections above 30% of a batch → read the reasons and update constraints. A fact rejection means fixing the ledger before the next edit.
DR16: never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems (for example a filmed street sign or house number, or a face without consent).
learning_questions: Does the backstage hero («Что тут будет?», curiosity_gap/backstage) produce coded sign-ups per 1k views, or only shares and views, compared with the conversion series (relief/wa_question, participation/reply)?

How many coded pre-opening sign-ups turn into visits in days 1–14 (tick-sheet «видео в Instagram» against the opted-in list)? Is a coded opt-in a usable leading indicator for a café launch? This is a pooled learning for the launch_or_event and specialty_coffee arms.
Which source brings more coded sign-ups per unit of effort: Reels, or the warm base (counter card plus Status codes)?
Do the honest_signal (ID06) and identity (ID13) wildcards earn above-median shares/1k from Астана viewers, and does ID06 shift the tick-sheet visit spread from day 1 into days 2–14?

Shared experiment: does a consented barista face in frame 1 (ID05, ID06) vs hands-only frame 1 (ID03, ID19, ID24) change 3-second hold? Logged per post for cross-client pooling; directional only at this n.

REALISM: organic ratio ≈1–33 (stretch to unrealistic), and an IG account grown around location 1 may not reach Левый берег. Mitigation: warm base, a 2GIS card before opening, an optional geo-boost (DR9), and an honest report on 2026-10-23 (DR12). No views target is promised.
TIMELINE: 21 days is too short for arms to learn, so the read-outs are allocation calls, not proven winners (DR13). The opening date may slip, so nothing in copy names it.

STAFF LOAD: staff are also setting up location 2, and the week-1 card spans two sites (14.1 min planned). If the Tuesday shoot cannot cover both, new-site shots are done by whoever is at the new site during setup, and DR14 applies after one bad week.
CONSENT: each barista's on-camera consent must be recorded before the first face shot (ID05, ID06). Opening-day guests appear only with an on-camera «да». No minors.

FIRST FRAMES: ID03 and ID13 both involve a door, so they are kept on non-adjacent days with a steam-first cover for ID13. ID05 and ID06 are both barista talk in «тихий угол», so they go in different weeks.
CANNIBALISATION: pushing location-1 regulars may lower location 1's checks (DR-C guardrail).
BROADCAST: the opening-day message goes only to contacts who replied «да». Never to the full contact list.
LANGUAGE/MUSIC: Kazakh captions only after a native speaker checks them. Commercial-library music only, with real sound kept on top.
AVOID: the two-bank joke (ID13) stays about the commute and weather, never about people. No naming other Левый берег coffee shops.
SECONDARY not served here: if location 2 needs baristas, hiring needs a separate brief with the «РАБОТА» code family and takes no launch slots.
JUDGMENT: weeks 3–4 list ID05/ID17/ID24 as provisional re-cuts or repeats. Real allocation comes from week-1/2 data.

refutations.target: ID06 «Честно: в первый день не приходите»
refutations.why_fails: Tells people to stay away when I asked for buzz. «Притираемся к новой машине» signals a specialty coffee shop that isn't ready. Embarrassing for the brand.
refutations.fix: Drop it. Handle capacity with extra staff on opening day, not by asking guests not to come.

refutations.target: Hiding the date and address behind a code (default Q1=2, CTA «дату и адрес — лично, по коду»)
refutations.why_fails: Nobody messages a coffee shop to get its address; they look in 2GIS. The plan itself opens a 2GIS card for the new location before opening, which reveals the address. The «secret» is contradictory and adds friction to the main action.
refutations.fix: Owner confirms the date and address in writing today. Put them in the videos, bio and 2GIS. Use the code for «напомним в день открытия» or for a real offer.

refutations.target: ID05 «Дату назовём, когда будем уверены»
refutations.why_fails: Saying two weeks before opening that we don't know the date looks disorganised and kills intent.
refutations.fix: After the date is confirmed, answer directly: date, address, how to find the entrance.

refutations.target: Budget 0 ₸, no offer, boost decision deferred to 19.10
refutations.why_fails: The plan's own REALISM math says organic reach from ~2.1k followers won't deliver. A boost started at D−11 doesn't have time to learn. No event, no tasting and no offer makes this content without a reason to come.
refutations.fix: Decide the geo-boost budget now and start from the first qualifying post. Add a preview evening for location 1 regulars, coffee drop-offs at nearby offices, and one measurable offer on the owner's terms for days 1–14.

output.persona: veteran_creator — short-form creator and SMM for local businesses in Kazakhstan/CIS (Астана coffee and HoReCa launches)
output.best_idea: ID13 «POV: любимая кофейня — на другом берегу» is the strongest idea, followed by ID18, the archive before/after. ID13 is the only piece built around something every Астана viewer recognises: the bridge, the traffic and the coffee going cold. People will send it to a friend, and the comment prompt «Вы с какого берега?» is easy to answer. ID18 costs the staff no time and suits the regulars. I'd make ID13 the template for the hero series: lead with recognisable Левый берег geography (the view from the new window, the ЖК or БЦ, the route people walk), not with a generic empty room.

refutations.target: Core mechanic: hiding the address behind «Напишите {CODE} — пришлём дату и адрес лично» in every video (and the 40/80/150 coded sign-up target)
refutations.why_fails: For a local café, the location is what makes people share. «Смотри, открывают у нас в ЖК / возле БЦ X» gets forwarded. «Где-то на Левом берегу, напиши им код» does not, because the person receiving it can't tell whether it's near them. Nobody in Астана DMs a code to a coffee shop to find out where it is. They write «где это?» in the comments or ignore the video. The plan also contradicts itself: it wants a 2GIS card for the new location live before opening, and that card publishes the address. So withholding the address makes the videos weaker and doesn't keep anything secret. The coded-DM targets will come in far below 40, and the plan's main metric will make the campaign look like a failure even if people do turn up.
refutations.fix: Ask the owner one question: can we name the landmark (ЖК or БЦ name, street, «напротив …»)? It's the same place where the 2GIS card goes. Put the landmark in the hook of every episode. Only the date stays private. Make the measured action a comment or DM keyword: «Напишите ЛЕВЫЙ — напомним в день открытия». It takes the viewer one tap, works with an auto-reply, and still builds the opt-in list. Count comments with the keyword plus DMs, and drop the per-video code card. Use the code only on the counter card and in Status, where it's needed to attribute sign-ups.

refutations.target: Channels: relying on Instagram Reels from a ~2.1k account built around location 1 to reach people near the new site
refutations.why_fails: An account whose followers live around location 1 won't reach Левый берег through organic Reels in 3 weeks. The plan admits this (organic reach is 1–33× short of the target) but then leans on the counter card at location 1 and an optional boost. It leaves out the channels that actually reach a new Астана neighbourhood. One is the residential complex and office-building chats on WhatsApp and Telegram, where people really do ask «что открывают на первом этаже?». The other is the covered shopfront itself, which hundreds of the target people walk past every day.
refutations.fix: Add a zero-cost window poster on the new site: «Что тут будет? → Instagram @… / напишите ЛЕВЫЙ», with a QR code and its own code so sign-ups from it are counted separately. It's printed on an office printer, so it costs about 0 ₸ in line with the budget, but the owner still approves it. Give the owner a 2-line text and the ID03 clip, and ask them to post it once in 2–3 nearby building chats they or the staff belong to (with the chat admin's OK, no spamming). Tag the new building as the location on every post. These steps bring in more sign-ups than Reels from a 2.1k account.

refutations.target: ID03 «Пустая комната… Что будет? → Здесь будет кофейня»
refutations.why_fails: The curiosity gap is fake. It's posted by a coffee shop's account, a tamper appears at second 5, and the reveal is «кофейня». Viewers know the answer in the first second. Empty room, tamper clink, shaking a bag of beans: every café opening in the CIS has posted this exact sequence. It looks like an ad, and the hint cards slow it down. A walk-through of an empty room shot on a weak phone in fit-out light looks grey and messy.
refutations.fix: Make the question about the place, not the product. Open on the view from the new window (a Left Bank landmark, the courtyard, the bus stop) with the hook «Узнаёте этот двор? Скоро здесь будет ваш утренний кофе». Locals recognise their own street, comment «это же …!», and forward it. Show the room from the door inward in 1–2 seconds, then reveal the cup. Shoot with the window as backlight so the phone's exposure works for you. That's one 10-second shot.

refutations.target: ID05 «Где именно? Когда?» — a barista explaining why we don't say the date yet
refutations.why_fails: This is a talking head that answers a question with «we won't tell you». Nobody saves or forwards a non-answer. It's 22 seconds of filler, and putting a face on screen to deliver it also uses up the barista's on-camera consent. With an anonymised «Нам пишут» bubble before real messages exist, it reads like an ad.
refutations.fix: Cut it, or have it answer the questions it can: the landmark, the opening hours, what's on the menu (once the owner has confirmed), and whether there's somewhere to sit with a laptop. End with «дату пришлём — напишите ЛЕВЫЙ». Give it 12 seconds and one take.

refutations.target: No reason to come on opening day: no offer, no event, nothing for «ажиотаж»
refutations.why_fails: The owner asked for ажиотаж. The plan delivers a waiting list and then a video telling people not to come on day one (ID06). With no price offer and no moment to show up for, the opening is just a quiet unlock of the door. The coded list gets a message with an address and nothing else. The barely-used opt-in list wastes the one advantage this plan builds.
refutations.fix: Put one free or almost-free ritual in front of the owner that can be filmed: guests write their name or street on a «первые соседи» wall, or the baristas from location 1 make the drinks during the first week («ваш бариста теперь и на Левом»), or there's a sticker or stamp for the first week. That gives the opening-day message and the opening-week videos something worth showing, and it spreads visits over the week without promising «первым N».

refutations.target: ID06 «Честно: в первый день не приходите»
refutations.why_fails: It contradicts the owner's brief («ажиотаж»), so the owner will very likely reject it, and a rejected wildcard is a wasted slot. To a viewer who doesn't know the café, it also says «we're not ready yet». The plan's own capacity worry is hypothetical, since we don't know the new site's throughput.
refutations.fix: Keep it in reserve and only use it if DR10 actually triggers (queues or wait complaints in opening week). In that situation it's a genuine, relevant post. Before then, make the same honest point another way: «Утром до 9 — быстро на вынос, после 10 — посидеть».

refutations.target: ID19 test-shot tally and ID24 strange order
refutations.why_fails: ID19 depends on the machine being installed and dialled in before the window ends, and on staff keeping a tally over several days while they're busy. Pouring dozens of shots down the drain also invites «перевод продукта» comments. ID24 is filmed at location 1, has nothing to do with Левый берег, and ends with a new-location call to action that doesn't fit, so it's attention with no route to sign-ups. Neither will bring in people near the new site.
refutations.fix: Swap ID24 for the window-view or route episode («от остановки X до нашей двери — 90 секунд», filmed handheld and sped up). Keep ID19 only if the machine arrives before 20 Oct. Otherwise drop it and don't keep the tally sheet.

refutations.target: Owner and staff load: 7 owner asks, shoots at two sites, consent recordings, tick sheets
refutations.why_fails: The staff are also setting up location 2, and the week-1 card needs two sites plus a quiet corner plus a voice note plus a tally. In practice the shoot either slips or gets done badly. The owner has to answer 3 numbered questions by noon tomorrow, plus 4 more. The owner will reply to one of them.
refutations.fix: Combine everything into one owner message with three yes/no taps (confirm the new site and filming / can we name the landmark / approve the reply text). Plan week 1 at the new site only: 3 hands-only shots, 12 minutes. Location 1 content comes from the archive (ID18) and ID13's single doorway shot, taken by whoever is opening that morning.

refutations.target: Language: Russian-only on-screen text for a Левый берег audience
refutations.why_fails: Many young office workers and residents on Левый берег are Kazakh-speaking. A launch that is all Russian loses part of the local share potential. Waiting for a «native check» with no named checker means it never happens.
refutations.fix: Ask the baristas, if any are native Kazakh speakers, to write a one-line Kazakh version of the hook for ID13 and the window-view episode. Use it as a bilingual title card and check it with the same barista.

output.name: Left Bank launch v2 — «Узнаёте это место?» (the neighbours' view, one word for a reminder, a week-long opening ritual)
output.big_idea: People on Левый берег learn about the new coffee shop the way a neighbour would. They see the view from its window (their own street, courtyard or bus stop), the room behind the glass, the people who will make their morning coffee, and an opening week they can take part in. The address and landmark are public, the same as on the 2GIS card. Viewers comment or DM one word, «ЛЕВЫЙ», to get a reminder on opening day. Generative: 20+ episodes come from the window view across the fit-out, real neighbour questions, the regulars' preview and the opening-week ritual. Provable: everything is filmed on site. Measurable: the keyword per post, the codes on the poster, counter card and Status, and POS checks from opening day. Truth gate: nothing runs until the owner confirms in writing the location, the landmark or address we may name, and permission to film the new site (E02, E21).
output.single_minded_message_ru: Узнаёте это место? Скоро здесь кофе
output.why_this_wins:
The ledger is empty, so the message cites no fact ids yet. It is true by construction once the owner confirms the location and that the site may be filmed (E02, E21 → NEEDS FACT). Every insight is strength ≤2, so this is a learning bet, not a forecast (L001).

What changed from v1, and why:
(1) Location is the thing people share. The landmark or address now goes in the hook and on screen of every episode, wherever the owner allows it (same data as the 2GIS card). This fixes the contradiction in v1, which hid the address in videos while publishing it on 2GIS. A forwarded line like «смотри, это же у нас во дворе» only works if the place is recognisable. I03 (moment: a closed shopfront on the daily route, E21/E18/E11/E23) is re-dramatised as the view from the window, not an empty-room-plus-tamper cliché.
(2) The measured action is now one tap: comment or DM «ЛЕВЫЙ», and we remind you on opening day. In v1 people had to DM a code to get an address, which nobody does (I02 friction, E02/E03/E15/E26/E09/E25). The keyword also opts people in to the opening-day message.
(3) Most of the volume comes from channels outside Reels, because the REALISM ratio (≈1–33 organic) says a ~2.1k account built around location 1 cannot reach Левый берег alone. These are: a window poster on the covered shopfront, 2–3 nearby building chats posted by the owner, a geo-boost decided now (not on 19.10), the location-1 counter card and a regulars' preview evening (I04/I05 warm base, E05/E14/E16/E22).
(4) «Ажиотаж» gets a real reason to come: an opening-week ritual with the owner's offer, redeemed at the till with the same word. Visits spread naturally across a week-long ritual, so nobody is told not to come. ID06 is dropped, and capacity is handled by staffing.
(5) Staff load is cut to ≤10 min/week of filming. The ID19 tally, voice notes and opening-week tick sheet are gone, and one named person answers messages behind an instant auto-reply.

Learning plan: 5 posts in week 1 across 5 drivers (curiosity_gap, identity, amusement_awe, story, relief). Each is read at 48 h internally, and the target is re-fixed on 16.10. The owner sees only a 3-number Monday report; allocation statistics stay inside code. JUDGMENT: F6 assumes a 4-week runway, but here there are 3 weeks before opening, so reach and conversion run together from week 1.

offer.proposal: Нужно ваше «да» и точные условия. Вариант по умолчанию без денег — «Неделя первых соседей», с [дата открытия] по [дата открытия + 6 дней]: на новой точке висит доска «Первые соседи», каждый гость может написать своё имя или улицу. Это можно снимать (гостей — только с их «да» на камеру). Плюс, по вашему выбору, одно предложение по слову «ЛЕВЫЙ» на кассе с [дата открытия] по [дата открытия + 13 дней]: [ваши точные слова — что получает гость, лимит в день, только на новой точке]. Варианты без скидки: наклейка или штамп «первая неделя» на стакане; бариста первой точки за стойкой в первую неделю (только если это правда). Без «первым N», без «успейте», без «только в день открытия». Слово «ЛЕВЫЙ» пробивается на кассе отдельной кнопкой, поэтому бумажный учёт не нужен.

Reach plus the shop window. Every post carries the location tag of the new building (once the address is confirmed) and the city «Астана». measurement.success_metric: Primary, pre-opening: reminder sign-ups for the new location, meaning unique contacts who sent «ЛЕВЫЙ» in comments or DM, or a code from the poster, counter card, building chat or Status. Deduped by contact. Target by 30.10: conservative 60 / expected 120 / stretch 250. These are assumptions: baseline 0, and the target was raised from v1's 40/80/150 because the keyword takes one tap and the poster, chats and boost add sources. Re-fixed on 16.10 from week-1 sign-ups per 1k views and per source. Forecast in visits [ASSUMPTION 30–50% sign-up→visit]: about 18–30 / 36–60 / 75–125 traced first visits in days 1–14, re-estimated from «ЛЕВЫЙ» till presses. Business objective, read 30.11: average daily POS checks at the new location over days 1–28 reach ≥50% of location 1's 4-week daily average (ratio and date are assumptions; the absolute number is set once the owner sends location 1's POS average). The owner's Monday report carries 3 numbers only: (1) sign-ups; (2) regulars who said they'll come (counter-card/Status codes plus preview RSVPs); (3) POS checks at the new location from opening day, with «ЛЕВЫЙ» presses at the till.
measurement.attribution: Comments containing «ЛЕВЫЙ» are attributed to the post they sit on. DMs are attributed by the per-post {CODE} prefilled in the caption and pinned-comment link; DMs without a code are counted as Reels-unattributed. The poster, counter card, building chats, Status and office cards each carry their own {CODE}. JUDGMENT: v1's per-video code card in the video was replaced by one viewer-facing keyword. Per-post attribution is preserved by comment location and link codes, which departs from L3's spoken/on-screen code. Coded and keyword counts are a floor; codeless «новая точка» messages asked «Откуда узнали?» are an estimate. At the till, «ЛЕВЫЙ» is a POS button (0 ₸, or the owner's offer line) on days 1–14. It replaces the paper tick sheet and is directional. New-location POS vs location 1's average is directional and labelled. Attribution window: 30 days.

shares + saves per 1,000 views (the «это же у нас во дворе» forward)
sign-ups per source per week (Reels vs poster vs chats vs counter card vs boost)
Астана audience share (if the owner grants insights access)
measurement.review_cadence: Internal (agent only): each post at 48 h and 7 days; daily sign-up count from 23.10 through opening week. Owner: a Monday report with 3 numbers, ≤5 lines, read within the 5 min/week (12.10, 19.10, 26.10, 02.11, 09.11). Template: «Неделя N: записались на напоминание — X (из них витрина/чаты/стойка — Y). Постоянные гости, что придут, — Z. Чеки на новой точке — W, нажатий „ЛЕВЫЙ“ — V. Дальше: … Нужно от вас: … (по умолчанию …)». Target re-fix 16.10. Phase review 09.11. Business read 30.11.

decision_rules: Owner-facing simplicity: allocation statistics run inside code and never appear in the owner report. The owner sees 3 numbers and at most one decision a week.
DR1 Read: each post at 48 h and 7 days. M = IG Reels median of the last 15 posts (fetched by 11.10; planning value 300–1,000 [ASSUMPTION]).

DR2 Breakout: ≥3×M views at 48 h, or shares+saves/1k ≥2× the account median. Within 3 days: 2 follow-ups (part 2 plus a reply to the top comment), pin it, put it on Status, and it is boost-eligible. ≥10×M is reported as «вирусный — редкий случай, не план».
DR3 Hook failure: 3-second hold <0.7× the account median → re-cut with a new first frame and hook, repost ≥7 days later, once only. No pre-opening reposts after 28.10.

DR5 Conversion-layer check on 21.10: if total sign-ups are <20 or sign-ups/1k <0.3 → before making more content, check that the keyword card is visible ≥2 s, the caption and pinned link, the auto-reply firing, the poster QR and the bio link.

DR-R Reply guardrail: the auto-reply answers instantly. If the named person's median human reply to follow-up questions exceeds 60 min in working hours over 3 days, tell the owner it is the top leak and pause the boost until fixed.

DR-Q1 Facts gate: landmark, address, date, hours, menu, seating and offer appear in audience copy only from written owner facts. If the date slips, update the bio, poster and 2GIS the same day. Posts already out stay up, and none of them counts down.

DR9 Boost: approved at onboarding. Start on the first qualifying post (DR2, or from 16.10 the best week-1 post by shares+saves/1k with ≥1 sign-up), within the owner's total budget and cap per sign-up. Stop after spending 5× the cap with <3 sign-ups, or after cost per sign-up rises for 3 days. Never with an unconfirmed offer.

DR10 Capacity: if opening-week checks reach ≥80% of the owner's stated daily capacity, or comments or reviews mention long waits → ask the owner for extra staff or a shift from location 1, pause the boost, and shift posts to the week-long «Первые соседи» ritual. Never tell people not to come.
DR-C Cannibalisation: if location 1's weekly checks fall >10% below its 4-week average for 2 weeks after opening → remove the counter card, and aim content at new Левый берег people only.
DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a fact (date, address, offer) → pause that series, verify with the owner, and tell the owner the same day.

DR12 Pivot on 23.10: if sign-ups are <15 (25% of conservative) → move effort to the poster, chats, counter card and boost, and send the owner a 3-option note (raise the boost / add office drop-offs / accept a smaller opening list).
DR13 Claims: no «победитель» in any report. The owner hears «лидирует, рано судить» at this n.
DR14 Staff: the weekly card is ≤10 min. If it is not completed in any one week → the next card uses 1 location, face-free shots and zero-minute ideas (ID17, ID18 types).
DR16: never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems.
learning_questions: Which source brings the most «ЛЕВЫЙ» sign-ups per unit of effort before opening: Reels, the window poster, building chats, the counter card or the boost?

Does showing the recognisable place in frame 1 (window view plus landmark, ID03) earn more shares/1k and sign-ups/1k than the identity and amusement wildcards (ID13, ID24)? This is pooled for the launch_or_event arms.
How many pre-opening sign-ups turn into «ЛЕВЫЙ» till presses in days 1–14, and is a keyword reminder list a usable leading indicator for a café launch?
Does the week-long «Первые соседи» ritual spread first visits across days 1–7 (daily POS checks) without queues?
Shared experiment: does a consented barista face in frame 1 (ID05) vs hands or place in frame 1 (ID03, ID24, ID13) change 3-second hold? Directional only at this n; logged for pooling.

owner_asks.ask: Я ИИ-помощник вашей кофейни. Подтвердите письменно сегодня: 1) вторая точка — по адресу ___ ; в роликах можно назвать ориентир ___ (ЖК, БЦ, улица или «напротив …»); 2) дата открытия: ___ (или «пока не точная»); 3) новое помещение можно снимать уже сейчас: да / нет. По умолчанию, если не ответите до 10.10 12:00: снимаем только первую точку, ориентир не называем.
owner_asks.why: E02, E21 and the landmark/date facts are the truth gate for the hero series, the bio, the poster and the 2GIS card. Every address string needs a ledger fact.

owner_asks.ask: Повод прийти на открытие: 1 — «Неделя первых соседей» (доска, где гости пишут имя или улицу), без скидок; 2 — плюс ваше предложение по слову «ЛЕВЫЙ» на кассе в первые 14 дней: напишите точно, что получает гость и лимит в день; 3 — бариста первой точки работают на новой в первую неделю (только если это так); 4 — ничего. И кто дополнительно выйдет на смену в день открытия? По умолчанию: 1.
owner_asks.why: The boss asked for a reason to come and a measurable offer; every offer and every claim about staff needs the owner's exact terms. Opening-day staffing replaces telling people not to come.

owner_asks.ask: Продвижение лучшего ролика вокруг нового адреса (решаем сейчас, чтобы стартовать с 16.10): 1 — нет; 2 — до 20 000 ₸; 3 — до 50 000 ₸; 4 — своя сумма ___. Максимум за одну запись на напоминание: ___ ₸ или «посчитайте сами». По умолчанию: 1.
owner_asks.why: A boost decided on 19.10 cannot learn before opening. Spend needs explicit approval (L8); the amounts are options, not recommendations.

owner_asks.ask: Кто отвечает на вопросы в директе в рабочее время в течение 15 минут (имя)? И одобрите автоответ: «Здравствуйте! Я ИИ-помощник кофейни. Записали: напомним о дне открытия новой точки здесь, в директе. Не нужно — напишите „стоп“.» 1 — да; 2 — поправлю. По умолчанию: отвечаете вы.
owner_asks.why: The sign-up desk and the reply guardrail need one named person; the auto-reply is customer contact and needs approval.

owner_asks.ask: Три цифры: 1) сколько чеков в день в среднем на первой точке за последние 4 недели; 2) сколько гостей в день новая точка спокойно обслужит в первую неделю; 3) можно ли на кассе завести кнопку «ЛЕВЫЙ» (да/нет). Если кнопки нет — считаем только общее число чеков.
owner_asks.why: Sets the absolute business objective, the DR10 capacity trigger, and replaces the paper tick sheet with a till count.

owner_asks.ask: Печатаем на офисном принтере (макеты пришлём): плакат на витрину новой точки «Что тут будет? Кофейня. Напишите „ЛЕВЫЙ“ — напомним в день открытия» с QR и карточку на стойку первой точки — 1 да / 2 нет. Карточка новой точки в 2ГИС: 1 — черновик готовим мы, вы подтверждаете; 2 — сами. По умолчанию: 1 и 1.
owner_asks.why: The poster and the counter card reach the target people that a 2.1k Reels account cannot; the 2GIS card lets people save the place.

owner_asks.ask: Опубликуйте один раз наш текст и ролик в 2–3 чатах соседних домов или офисов, где вы или сотрудники уже состоите (с согласия админа чата) — 1 да / 2 нет. Закрытый вечер для постоянных гостей первой точки на новой точке за 1–2 дня до открытия: 1 — да, дата ___, до ___ гостей; 2 — нет. Кофе в 2–3 соседних офиса в дни открытия (кто отвезёт?): 1 — да; 2 — нет. По умолчанию: 1, 2, 2.
owner_asks.why: Building chats and the regulars' preview are the cheapest local reach and the warm base. The office drop-offs and the evening cost the owner's money and people.

owner_asks.ask: Пришлите 5 фото или видео первой точки до открытия (пустое помещение, ремонт, первая чашка) как файлы. Если нет — ответьте «нет», ролик уберём.
owner_asks.why: ID18 (zero staff minutes) cannot run without real archive images; AI past imagery is banned.

owner_asks.ask: Каждый понедельник: отчёт из 3 цифр и пакет роликов — ответьте «да» или номерами тех, что убрать. Без ответа до среды 12:00 ничего не публикуем.
owner_asks.why: L8 batch approval within the 5 min/week owner budget; the report is cut to 3 numbers per the owner's request.

risks: DROPPED: ID06 («в первый день не приходите») after the owner's fatal refutation; capacity is handled by staffing (DR10) and the week-long ritual. ID19 (test-shot tally) dropped to cut staff load during setup.

JUDGMENT: the boss wants the date and address in the videos, while the creator wanted the date kept private. Precedence goes to the owner: the address or landmark is public once confirmed, and the date is public once firm. The keyword is a reminder, not a gate to information.

JUDGMENT: ID03 and ID05 keep their ids and arms (curiosity_gap/backstage, relief/wa_question) but are re-specced at edit: the ID03 hook becomes «Узнаёте это место? Скоро здесь кофе» (6 words) on a window-view first frame; ID05 becomes a 12 s factual answer. Both go back through the H1–H3 rails before publishing.
NEEDS FACT: written owner confirmation of the second location, its address, and the landmark that may be named (owner). Every hero hook depends on it.
NEEDS FACT: permission to film the new site now, and window backlight and noise from the reality scan (owner + staff). If filming is refused, the hero moves to location 1 and ID03/ID04 wait.
NEEDS FACT: the opening date (owner). Until it is firm, copy says «скоро», with no countdown.
NEEDS FACT: opening hours, menu items, and whether laptop seating exists (owner) before ID05 says any of them.
NEEDS FACT: the exact opening-week ritual and offer terms, dates and daily limit (owner). No «первым N», no «успейте».
NEEDS FACT: whether location-1 baristas staff the new site in week 1 (owner) before any «ваш бариста теперь и на Левом».
NEEDS FACT: whether the POS can log a «ЛЕВЫЙ» button (owner). If not, till attribution falls back to total POS checks.

NEEDS FACT: the named reply person (owner), and whether the auto-reply and comment-to-DM tool works on this Instagram account (agent check). If it doesn't, the named person replies manually within 15 min.
NEEDS FACT: location 1 is not on Левый берег (owner). If it is, drop ID13 and reword the counter card.
NEEDS FACT: ≥2 real where/when comments before ID05 uses their wording; otherwise the hook is «Где и когда? Отвечаем».
NEEDS FACT: a real odd order recalled by staff at the shoot (ID24), and archive photos (ID18). Otherwise drop the idea and pull a reserve.
NEEDS FACT: building-chat admins' OK (owner). No posting in chats the owner or staff are not already members of.
REALISM: even with the new sources, the sign-up targets are assumptions. Mitigation: the poster, chats, counter card, a boost decided now, and the DR12 note on 23.10. No views target is promised.
STAFF LOAD: the filming card is ≤10 min/week (week 1 ≈8.3–9.3 min). There are no voice notes and no paper tally, and the till button is one tap in the normal sale flow.
CONSENT: barista consent is recorded on camera before ID05. Opening guests at the «Первые соседи» board appear only with an on-camera «да»; no minors.
BROADCAST: the opening-day message goes only to contacts who sent «ЛЕВЫЙ», a code or a «да»; «стоп» removes the contact.
CANNIBALISATION: the counter card may pull regulars away from location 1 (DR-C).
AVOID: the two-bank joke (ID13) is about the commute and weather only. No naming other Левый берег cafés. Kazakh captions only after a native speaker checks them. Commercial-library music only.
SECONDARY not served: if location 2 needs baristas, that needs a separate hiring brief with the «РАБОТА» code family.

NEXT BATCH: preview-evening invitation (warm base) and a consented recap; «Неделя первых соседей» opening-week pieces filmed at the board with consent.
NEXT BATCH: «ваш бариста теперь и на Левом» (I05 character), only after staffing is confirmed; an office drop-off clip with consent if the owner chooses drop-offs.
NEXT BATCH: an I07 myth piece («спешелти — это долго?», as the barista's opinion, no price or speed claims) and an I09 first-cold-morning piece from optional steam footage.

output.persona: Владелец кофейни в Астане (гипотетическая), открываю вторую точку на Левом берегу через 3 недели. Хочу ажиотаж и гостей в первый месяц. Свободного времени у меня и у персонала нет: идёт запуск.
output.best_idea: Плакат на витрине новой точки и карточка на стойке первой точки. Плюс одно слово «ЛЕВЫЙ», чтобы получить напоминание в день открытия, и та же кнопка на кассе. Это дешёвый и честный способ дойти до людей, которые каждый день ходят мимо. Мой Instagram на 2,1 тыс. подписчиков сам до них не дотянется. А кнопка на кассе показывает настоящих гостей, а не просмотры. Серия «Узнаёте это место?» с видом из окна тоже хороша, но только если в кадре реально узнаётся двор или остановка.

refutations.target: Слейт (ID03, ID05, ID13, ID17, ID18, ID24) против кампании v2
refutations.why_fails: Карточки идей устарели. В ID03 так и осталось «Пустая комната… Что будет?», адрес спрятан, внизу карточка с кодом. Во всех CTA написано «Напишите {CODE} — пришлём дату и адрес лично». В тексте кампании другое: адрес открыт, а реакция — одно слово «ЛЕВЫЙ» для напоминания. В ID05 бариста говорит «Дату скажем, когда будем уверены», а кампания такую фразу прямо запрещает. Если персонал снимет по этим карточкам, мы получим ролики, которые противоречат и плакату, и 2ГИС, и мне.
refutations.fix: Переписать каждую карточку в слейте до того, как её получит персонал: hook_ru, on_screen_ru, cta_ru, say_ru и worker_shots под ритуал «вид из окна» и слово «ЛЕВЫЙ». Старые тексты с кодом за адрес убрать полностью. В карточку на съёмку 13.10 идут только исправленные версии.

refutations.target: Две разные цели успеха (intake 40/80/150 против measurement 60/120/250)
refutations.why_fails: В разделе intake цель — «коды за дату и адрес» до 30.10, в разделе measurement — «ЛЕВЫЙ» с другими цифрами. Я не понимаю, по какой из них меня будут отчитывать в понедельник. Получается, что цель подвинули задним числом.
refutations.fix: Оставить одну метрику: уникальные «ЛЕВЫЙ» плюс коды источников, 60/120/250, с пересмотром 16.10. Старую формулировку из intake удалить.

refutations.target: Вопросы ко мне (owner_asks) и срок «до 10.10 12:00»
refutations.why_fails: Сегодня 10.10, и срок ответа по сути уже прошёл. Вопросов девять, по плану на них уходит 2+2+1+2+2+1+2+1+5 = 18 минут. Обещали не больше 15 минут на старт, а в week 0 вообще пишут «≤13 мин». Внутри ещё вложенные варианты: офисы, закрытый вечер, чаты домов, бюджет, лимит на запись. В разгар запуска я столько не прочитаю.
refutations.fix: Одним сообщением прислать только три критичных вопроса: подтверждён ли адрес и ориентир, можно ли снимать помещение, какой бюджет на продвижение (да/нет плюс сумма). Остальное спрашивать по одному вопросу в день в течение недели, срок перенести на 11.10 вечер. Счёт минут проверить заново.

refutations.target: Ажиотаж и повод прийти: «Неделя первых соседей» по умолчанию без предложения
refutations.why_fails: Я просил ажиотаж. По умолчанию мне предлагают доску, где гости пишут имя или улицу, без скидки и без подарка. Это не повод ехать в новую кофейню. Если я не дам условия акции, на открытии будет только напоминание «мы открылись». Поэтому прогноз 36–60 визитов с напоминаний выглядит оптимистично.
refutations.fix: Дать мне 2–3 готовых варианта акции с ценой для меня: например, второй напиток в подарок по слову «ЛЕВЫЙ» первые 14 дней, лимит N в день, только на новой точке. Посчитать стоимость через мой средний чек. Доску оставить дополнением к акции. Писать имя на доске не обязательно (приватность), улицы хватит.

refutations.target: Неделя 1: 2 из 5 слотов — подстановочные ID13 и ID24 («Странный заказ»)
refutations.why_fails: До открытия 16 дней публикаций. У ID24 оценка objective_fit = 2, и к новой точке он отношения не имеет. Это пост ради охвата, а охват по моей базе в Астане Левый берег не приводит. ID13 зависит от непроверенного факта, что первая точка не на Левом берегу. При этом в неделе 4 они снова стоят в списке.
refutations.fix: ID24 заменить вторым эпизодом «Узнаёте это место?» или ответом на реальный вопрос из чатов домов. ID13 оставить только после моего подтверждения про первую точку. Подстановочные идеи до открытия — максимум 1 из 5.

refutations.target: Механика «комментарий ЛЕВЫЙ → мгновенный автоответ в директ»
refutations.why_fails: На этой механике держится вся главная метрика. Но в Instagram нет встроенного автоответа в директ на комментарий: нужен сторонний сервис, и в плане стоит лишь «agent check». Если сервис не подключится, комментаторы останутся без ответа. Рассылка в день открытия тогда не дойдёт, а обещание «напомним» мы нарушим публично.
refutations.fix: До 12.10 проверить и подключить инструмент (или сказать, что его нет). Запасной вариант прописать заранее: ответственный вручную отвечает на каждый «ЛЕВЫЙ» дважды в день. Плюс сохранённый список, и напоминание уходит в директ в день открытия. Цель по записям ограничить тем, сколько сообщений человек реально успевает обработать.

refutations.target: Сложность всего плана (10 каналов, ~15 правил DR, 5 типов кодов)
refutations.why_fails: Плакат, стойка, чаты домов, Status, буст, 2ГИС, офисы, Reels, TikTok, закрытый вечер — и всё это за 3 недели при одном телефоне и персонале, занятом запуском. Каждый канал со своим {CODE}. Кто-то перепутает QR, и вся атрибуция развалится. Мне важно, чтобы это сделали, а не красиво посчитали.
refutations.fix: Свести к ядру: Reels, плакат, карточка на стойке, 2ГИС, буст. Чаты домов и офисы оставить опциями после 19.10. TikTok/YouTube убрать до открытия. QR и коды генерирует и печатает агент, мне приходит уже готовый PDF.

refutations.target: Цель бизнеса «≥50% чеков первой точки» и прогноз визитов
refutations.why_fails: Порог 50% взят с потолка, и конверсия из записи в визит 30–50% тоже предположение. Если в отчёте окажется 45%, я не пойму, провал это или нормально для новой точки на новом берегу.
refutations.fix: Подписать в отчёте, что 50% — ориентир, а не норма. После 7 дней работы пересчитать его по фактическим чекам дней 1–7 и моим данным о вместимости.

refutations.target: Буст: потолок за одну запись и старт 16.10
refutations.why_fails: Формула потолка требует моего среднего чека, маржи и частоты визитов, а этих данных ещё нет. Без них буст на 20–50 тыс. ₸ стартует без потолка или не стартует вовсе. Плюс радиус 1,5–2 км вокруг новой точки — тоже предположение.
refutations.fix: Если я не дал цифры к 15.10, взять жёсткий потолок по умолчанию (например, 500 ₸ за запись) и дневной лимит. Через 3 дня прислать мне одну строку: сколько потрачено и сколько записей.

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local businesses in Kazakhstan/CIS. I judge on whether a barista can shoot it on one weak phone in 20 minutes, whether people in Astana would forward it, and whether it brings real inquiries.
output.best_idea: The window poster on the closed shopfront, paired with the «Узнаёте это место?» series that opens on the view from the new window. This is how a new café actually gets talked about on Левый берег: people from the ЖК walk past the papered glass every day, see the poster, then see the same spot in their feed and forward it as «это же у нас во дворе». It is physical, local, free and repeatable. It also turns the fit-out, which you have to do anyway, into weekly episodes. Everything else in the plan should feed this.

refutations.target: Slate vs campaign v2 (ID03, ID05, all CTAs)
refutations.why_fails: The shot cards still carry the v1 specs. ID03 has tamper and bean hints, the reveal «Здесь будет кофейня» and the card «Дату и адрес — лично, по коду». ID05 says «Дату назовём, когда будем уверены», which the campaign explicitly bans. Every CTA is still «Напишите {CODE}», not «ЛЕВЫЙ». Staff get the slate cards, not the essay, so on Tuesday they will shoot the old version, and the editor will get two conflicting scripts for the same id.
refutations.fix: Regenerate the slate entries for ID03, ID05, ID13, ID17, ID18 and ID24 to the v2 spec before the Monday card goes out. That means new hook_ru, first_frame, on_screen_ru, cta_ru and worker_shots (ID03 becomes one 10 s window→room shot). Run a check that fails if any slate string contains «лично, по коду», «{CODE}» in cta_ru, or «когда будем уверены».

refutations.target: Keyword «ЛЕВЫЙ»
refutations.why_fails: In Russian slang «левый» means «random, shady, fake», as in «левый чувак» or «левый товар». A café asking people to comment «ЛЕВЫЙ» invites jokes like «левый кофе». It also reads oddly at the till: «скажите кассиру „левый“». In KZ comment sections people are used to «+», «хочу» or «где?».
refutations.fix: Use «КОФЕ», «РЯДОМ» or just «+» in comments. Keep the source codes in link prefill and QR codes, where the wording doesn't matter. Test the word with two baristas aged 20–25 before printing.

refutations.target: Opening-day reminder delivery via Instagram DM
refutations.why_fails: Automated comment-to-DM tools can't message people two to three weeks later: they only work inside Meta's 24 h window, plus 7 days with the human-agent tag. So the opening-day reminder becomes 60–250 near-identical DMs sent by hand. One person does that on the busiest day of the opening, and mass identical DMs from a 2.1k account risk an action block. The promise «напомним в день открытия» is the core of the CTA, and the plan never says who presses send or how.
refutations.fix: Add a countdown sticker with «Напомнить» to the pinned Stories/highlight as soon as the date is firm, so Instagram sends the native reminder. Ask people who sign up to save the WhatsApp number so Status and broadcast reach them. Spread any manual DMs over D−1 and D0 morning, split between 2 people, with message templates varied. Put this in the week-3 ai_work and the owner asks.

refutations.target: Week 1 shoot: ID03/ID05 at the new site plus ID13/ID24 at location 1 in a «~9 minute» session on 13.10
refutations.why_fails: The stated constraint is one session at ONE location, because staff are busy setting up location 2. ID13 (location 1 door) and ID24 (location 1 bar) can't be shot in the same 9 minutes as the new-site window shots without travel across the river. The 8.3–9.3 min estimate ignores this. ID24 also has objective_fit 2 and costs barista time in launch week for a post with no launch content.
refutations.fix: Split it. The new site gets ID03 and ID05 on Tuesday. Location 1 gets ID13 (8 s, hands only) whenever the shift there is quiet, filmed by whoever is on shift. Drop ID24 from week 1. Replace it with a zero-minute piece cut from reality-scan footage, or with a second hero cut from the same window clip using a different hook.

refutations.target: Hero series default when the landmark isn't confirmed («ориентир не называем»)
refutations.why_fails: «Узнаёте это место?» with no landmark, and a window view of a typical Левый берег ЖК courtyard or parking lot, looks like 500 other places. The hook only works if the frame or the text pins the location: a named ЖК, business centre or street, or a visible city landmark. With the owner-asks default set to «nothing named», the hero series becomes a generic empty-room video.
refutations.fix: Change the default to «name the ЖК/БЦ, which is already public on 2GIS», and ask the owner to opt OUT rather than in. In the reality scan, tell the barista to find the window angle with the most recognisable thing in it (sign of the ЖК, bus stop name, a landmark tower). If none exists, frame from the street outside looking at the shopfront and put the ЖК name in text.

refutations.target: Window backlight on a weak phone
refutations.why_fails: The hero shot goes from exposing for a bright window to turning into a dark, unlit fit-out room. Cheap phones hunt exposure for 1–2 seconds, so the room goes black and then pumps. The 'one thing that changed this week' then reads as mud.
refutations.fix: Shoot the window and the room as two separate clips and cut on the turn, with exposure locked by a long press on each. Shoot near midday with the work lights on. Add this to what_ru.

refutations.target: Building chats as «owner posts in chats they're already in»
refutations.why_fails: The owner of a Right Bank café is rarely a member of the ЖК chats around the new unit, so this channel will quietly produce zero. In Astana the gatekeeper for these chats is the ОСИ/КСК chairman or the building's management company.
refutations.fix: Owner ask: one message to the ОСИ/КСК of the new building (and 1–2 neighbouring ones) asking them to post the text and clip as a «новый сосед на первом этаже» announcement. Many will do it for free because a café improves the building. Offer a coffee for the chairman if the owner approves.

refutations.target: Owner onboarding time
refutations.why_fails: The owner asks add up to 2+2+1+2+2+1+2+1+5 = 18 minutes, against a stated limit of ≤15 minutes for onboarding. There are also 9 separate decisions, so the owner will answer 3 and the defaults will kill the hero series (see the landmark default).
refutations.fix: Merge everything into one numbered message of 6 lines at most. The truth gate (address, ЖК name, date, filming permission) and the reply person come first. Push the archive photos, office drop-offs and preview evening into next Monday's ask.

refutations.target: Missing local amplifier
refutations.why_fails: There is no plan for the local Левый берег micro-bloggers and city pages (Astana food and «что нового» accounts) that actually move a launch in KZ. With a ~2.1k account and the REALISM ratio of ≈1–33, Reels alone won't reach the catchment, and the boost decision is uncertain.
refutations.fix: Add an owner-approval option: a barter preview for 2–3 local micro-bloggers (5–20k, living on Левый берег) at the preview evening. They post with their own source code and the «ЛЕВЫЙ»/«+» mechanic. Coffee only, no claims, and the owner approves the exact terms.
